reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the title advertises a $100 Chipotle gift-card giveaway while the description says the gift card is not being given away, creating a contradictory promotion. No payment, data submission, link, or other transaction mechanism is identified, and the sampled frame and speech show only pointing and a confrontational remark.

opening.argument: The description directly withdraws the giveaway claim: “I'm sorry I'm not giving away” the gift card. Read together with the title, that is a correction, not a promise that viewers will receive a reward. Nothing supplied tells viewers to pay, submit information, follow a link, or take any other step to claim a card. The evidence therefore supports a misleading-sounding title followed by an explicit disclaimer, not a demonstrated deceptive solicitation.
